market_evidence.finding: Cold brew accounts for 28% of total away-from-home coffee consumption in US/CA, with 62% of Gen Z / Millennial consumers drinking cold coffee daily even during winter months.

market_evidence.source: D2C Coffee Appliance Review Mining (Amazon & Reddit r/Coffee, 1,450 verified purchase reviews)
market_evidence.finding: Top customer complaint with existing home cold brewers is 24-hour waiting friction (42% of negative reviews) followed by sludge/sediment in the final cup (31%).

market_evidence.source: Meta Ads & TikTok D2C Benchmark Q3 2025
market_evidence.finding: Kitchen hardware products priced $150-$250 face median customer acquisition cost (CAC) of $55-$75 on paid social, requiring multi-touch video demonstration of speed/clarity to achieve profitable 1st-order payback.
Specialty retailers (Williams Sonoma, Sur La Table) require minimum 45% wholesale discount and proven D2C brand search volume before committing to endcap placement.
